agent_runs.label: P12-06 intent/control dataset survey (inside the M4-11 + P12-06 agent run)

notes: Desk research, no downloads. wiki/questions/intent-datasets-survey.md: about 45 public datasets (implant, ECoG, EEG, EMG), licences read on the host pages or APIs (Dryad API, DANDI, Zenodo, PhysioNet, figshare, GitHub LICENSE), fit scores for the FEP-0003 intent and control profiles. Control (P12-03) top 3: BrainGate long-term recalibration (CC0, 1.69 GB), NLB MC_RTT (CC BY, 51 MB), BNCI 002-2025 EEG 2D trajectory (CC BY). Intent top 3: PhysioNet EEGMMIDB (ODC-By, 3.4 GB, rest events), BrainGate preparatory encoding (CC0, 1.54 GB), BNCI 001-2025 (CC BY). Both profiles but 8.2 GB: BrainGate drag-and-drop (CC0). No licence: BCI Competition III/IV (bbci.de), Ninapro, Tsinghua SSVEP, OpenBMI, CSL-HDEMG. NC: all Meta wrist-EMG sets; emg2qwerty README CC BY-NC 4.0 vs LICENSE file CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Sub-agent licence check: 329 s, 97,791 tokens, 64 tool uses.
